## PEC 1

La PEC 1 consiste en revisar una sere de fuentes para identificar tareas de interés en que se han clasificado algunos trabajos. La sfuentes son:

- [Proceedings of the Iberian Languages Evaluation Forum (IberLEF 2020)](https://sites.google.com/view/iberlef2020/home)
- [Proceedings of the Iberian Languages Evaluation Forum (IberLEF 2021)](https://sites.google.com/view/iberlef2021/home)
- [Proceedings of the Iberian Languages Evaluation Forum (IberLEF 2022)](https://sites.google.com/view/iberlef2022/home)

## Bibliografía

- [INLP] Dan Jurafsky, Chris Manning. Vídeo [Intro to NLP](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zQ6gzQ5YZ8o). Stanford Online at YouTube, 15/10/2012.
- [SLP2] Daniel Jurafsky, James H. Martin. [Speech and Language Processing: An Introduction to Natural Language Processing, Computational Linguistics, and Speech Recognition](http://www.cs.colorado.edu/~martin/slp2.html). 2.a ed. Pearson Prentice Hall, 2009.
